title: Looks Like You're Requesting A Refund
style: smooth jazz-pop, light brass, soft electric piano, polite female lead vocal with male harmony, brushed drums, 96 BPM, corporate-friendly, ironic-positive
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Looks like you're requesting a refund
One moment while I look up your information
Is this the Claude account you'd like to refund
Your organization — yes confirmation

[Pre-Chorus]
Let me check whether your subscription
Is eligible — polite procession

[Chorus]
Looks like you're requesting a refund
One moment while I look it up
Looks like you're requesting a refund
The bot is being warm enough
Looks like you're requesting a refund
Click yes and the wheel turns smooth
Fin AI doing it right for once
No loop, no fight, no proof

[Verse 2]
Quality of responses didn't meet my needs
That's the reason I selected from the list
You are eligible — but the sub is active
Must be cancelled — shall I do it twist

[Bridge]
Yes — I said yes
Got it — cancel and process
Five to ten business days
Funds appearing in the haze

[Final Chorus]
Looks like you're requesting a refund
This time the bot delivered clean
No emotional assumption attack
No loop, no scripted scene
Looks like you're requesting a refund
Proof it can be done
Why can't every Fin AI agent
Work like this one
